h.select_rule: Keep hypotheses whose direction contradicts the first intuitive guess but follows from parent quality (headroom, floor), saturation or redundancy. Drop rare conditions, tiny expected effects and pure connectivity stories. Keep at least five different edited fields or edit values.
h.strategy: Propose many diverse conditional hypotheses. For each one, first write the direction a quick reader would predict. Then ask whether the condition mostly picks out strong or weak parents, or parents that already contain the edited value or a close substitute. If it does, the measured effect is often the opposite of the quick prediction: gains shrink in strong parents, losses shrink in weak parents, and adding something already present gives little. Include edits that remove options, edits that swap between similar options, and edits toward the option that is usually best. State the direction your reasoning supports, even when it is the less intuitive one. Use conditions that hold for a large share of parents.
